text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: 1,600 meters… That's the same distance as the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (My body felt so unbelievably light then. Like it wasn't even me who was running, but someone else entirely…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (But now, I know I can display my true ability. Mine, and not someone else's.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Trainer and I have been working hard to make sure I can utilize my body's strength to the fullest. As long as I can use what I've learned…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I'm sure I can run better than I did at the Oka Sho! And then…)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I can show Trainer an even brighter future!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right! I can do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower gets changed, and we head to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: She does… I'm glad I didn't break her concentration.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I need to focus as well. I won't be able to do my best for all 1,600 meters of this race if I'm distracted.
